verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity-management SaaS with a documented API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions a sandbox, a test company, or any non-production environment. Per-integration service-account scoping and revocable tokens are access-control features, not isolation from production data, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
